name: google-health-token-tool
description: Google Health OAuth token tool for Vercel and local usage

scripts.test:redis: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const{Redis}=require("@upstash/redis");try{for(const l of fs.readFileSync(".env","utf8").split("\n")){const m=l.match(/^\s*([\w.-]+)\s*=\s*(.*)$/);if(m)process.env[m[1]]=m[2].trim().replace(/^([\x27"])(.*)\1$/,"$2")}}catch{}const url=process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL||process.env.KV_REST_API_URL;const token=process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN||process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN;if(!url||!token){console.error("❌ Missing Upstash/KV URL or Token in .env");process.exit(1);}const r=new Redis({url,token});r.ping().then(res=>console.log("✅ Redis PING response:",res)).catch(e=>console.error("❌ Connection failed:",e.message));'
